subject: Expansion: CareBridge clinical ops subsidiaries - onboarding & term recalibration
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Ruiz <michael.ruiz@carebridge.health>, Dr. Sara Patel <sara.patel@carebridge.health>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Expansion: CareBridge clinical ops subsidiaries - onboarding & term recalibration

Hi Michael and Sara,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, CareBridge is ready to expand the clinical ops workloads into two of your regional subsidiaries (Midwest Ops and WestCare Labs). To make this low friction for your teams we propose: 

- A staged rollout over 6 weeks (sandbox -> pilot -> full prod) per subsidiary
- Separate API keys per subsidiary for governance and logging
- A single amendment to your current MSA to reflect the extra projects and an adjusted commit (monthly token minimums)

I've attached a brief outline that maps the kickoff, milestones, and recommended owner list for each stage (carebridge-subsidiary-onboard-outline.pdf). Can you confirm:

1) Preferred kickoff week (we tentatively penciled 2026-05-17)
2) Who should be the primary technical contact at each subsidiary for key provisioning
3) Any procurement or legal deadlines we should align to for the amendment

Laura, looping you in to own the amendment and price impact analysis.

Next step: if Michael/Sara are good with the timeline we'll produce a short amendment + a provisioning checklist and start keying teams.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Michael Ruiz <michael.ruiz@carebridge.health>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Sara Patel <sara.patel@carebridge.health>
Cc: CareBridge Procurement <procurement@carebridge.health>
Date: 2026-05-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: CareBridge clinical ops subsidiaries - onboarding & term recalibration

Jonas — thanks, this looks good. We are keen to kick off but need to push the pilot start to the week of 2026-05-24 (ops availability). Primary contacts: 

- Midwest Ops: Daniel Kim (daniel.kim@carebridge.health)
- WestCare Labs: Priya Shah (priya.shah@carebridge.health)

I've attached a high-level org chart and the subsidiaries' technical POC list (carebridge-org-chart.xlsx). Procurement flagged that any amendment needs to be in our systems by the 31st of May so legal and terms should be prioritized.

Can you route the amendment draft to procurement@carebridge.health and to me?

Best,
Michael Ruiz
Director, Clinical Operations
CareBridge Health

Date: 2026-05-11T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: CareBridge clinical ops subsidiaries - onboarding & term recalibration

Team —

I reviewed the high-level ask and sketched the price impact given the additional two subsidiaries. Attached is an updated proforma that includes a 3-month ramp and projected token usage by squad (proforma-updated.xlsx). Notes: 

- Expected monthly token delta: +28% after steady state across the two subsidiaries
- If we keep the same per-token list price, the monthly invoice would exceed their current commit threshold — recommend a structured amendment with a tiered commit that scales down unit price at 3x and 10x thresholds
- We can offer a one-time onboarding credit to offset the first-month overage; suggest $10k credit to smooth procurement sign-off

Marissa — can you draft an amendment that: 1) enumerates the new project identifiers and keys, 2) includes the tiered volume pricing, and 3) includes the onboarding credit line? Ben, please confirm that the proposed credits and pricing fall within our discount guardrails.

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Account Management
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Ruiz <michael.ruiz@carebridge.health>, Dr. Sara Patel <sara.patel@carebridge.health>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CareBridge Procurement <procurement@carebridge.health>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: CareBridge clinical ops subsidiaries - onboarding & term recalibration

Hi Michael and Sara —

Appreciate the fast turn. Attached is a draft amendment (amendment-draft.docx) that: 

- Adds "Midwest Ops" and "WestCare Labs" as distinct projects under your account
- Lists two new API key namespaces (one per subsidiary) with described governance controls
- Proposes tiered commit thresholds with unit price reductions at 3x and 10x usage
- Includes a one-time $10,000 onboarding credit applied to the first invoice after full prod activation

We are also prepared to provide a staging set of API keys and a provisioning runbook; I included a DocuSign link below for review. If procurement confirms by 2026-05-31 we can begin provisioning week of 2026-05-24 as requested.

DocuSign (amendment): https://www.docusign.com/en/sign?envelopeId=5f3a9c

Next practical steps for CareBridge: 
1) Confirm procurement contact to receive the DocuSign (procurement@carebridge.health OK?)
2) Approve the amendment redline by 2026-05-20 for legal to intake
3) Confirm the technical POCs so we can pre-provision keys in staging

Jonas will run the kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference

Attachment: amendment-draft.docx

From: Michael Ruiz <michael.ruiz@carebridge.health>

Subject: Re: Expansion: CareBridge clinical ops subsidiaries - onboarding & term recalibration

All — this looks good to us. Procurement confirms the email above (procurement@carebridge.health) and will accept the DocuSign link. We approve the proposed amendment language and the $10k onboarding credit.

Please begin pre-provisioning the staging keys for Midwest Ops (daniel.kim) and WestCare Labs (priya.shah) and share the onboarding checklist. Also confirm how long keys will remain in staging before we flip to prod and if we can set a 30-day window for rollback in case of unexpected cost spikes.

PO request: procurement will issue a PO once they receive the final DocuSign. Target to have the DocuSign executed by 2026-05-21.

Thanks — excited to get the subsystems live.

Michael Ruiz

CareBridge Health
